lyrics.en: Side by side, the lovelier goes up
lyrics.zh: 并肩浮起，更美的那一颗先向上

lyrics.en: Reach for the top, till the bubble pops
lyrics.zh: 一路攀到最高处，直到气泡破裂

lyrics.en: Take a memory, insert to the past
Which one is the sweetest? Save it for the last
lyrics.zh: 哪一颗最甜？留到最后再尝

lyrics.en: If you turn into a table
You must be at the height of my elbows
lyrics.zh: 那一定正好到我手肘的高度

lyrics.en: Odd stubby leg makes you wobbly
lyrics.zh: 奇怪的小短腿，让你摇摇晃晃

lyrics.en: You're the only perfect table for me
lyrics.zh: 你就是我唯一完美的桌子

lyrics.en: If you turn into an eggplant
You'll be my purple friend
Scratchy nail marks on your body
lyrics.zh: 你身上那些指甲划出的痕迹

lyrics.en: You're the only perfect eggplant for me
lyrics.zh: 你就是我唯一完美的茄子

lyrics.en: I'm searching
If you're a cat
A little kitten
You must be blue point
Meowing a lot
Hissing a lot
But you never purr
If you're a steak
A fillet mignon covered in mushroom sauce
Browned on the outside
Medium-rare inside
If you turn into a flower
You must be the most delicate ever
lyrics.zh: 那一定是世上最娇嫩的一朵

lyrics.en: Even if you bloom just occasionally
You're the only perfect flower for me
lyrics.zh: 你就是我唯一完美的花

lyrics.en: If you turn into a human
I'd like all the warmth coming from your hands
lyrics.zh: 我想得到你掌心全部的暖

lyrics.en: Bit of stinky breath, with hair that's unruly
lyrics.zh: 呼吸有点臭，头发乱糟糟

lyrics.en: You're the only perfect human for me
lyrics.zh: 你就是我唯一完美的人

lyrics.en: I'm searching
If you're a piece
A piece of sheet
You must be… U-Um?
What,what's it called?
What's that word again?
"Do-o-o-o-ope"?
If you could stay
Stay there where you are
So I can… U-Um?
Oh,what,what's it called?
What's that word again?
"Lo-o-o-ove"?
I'm searching for
Searching for you everywhere
I can see you in most everything
lyrics.zh: 几乎万物里都能看见你

lyrics.en: I'm searching for
Searching for you everywhere
But somehow you can't stop transforming
lyrics.zh: 可不知为何，你总在不停变形

lyrics.en: I'm searching for, searching for, searching for
Searching for, searching for, searching for
A-Ah
I'm searching for, searching for, searching for
My old self that's gone since you have left
lyrics.zh: 你离开后，那个旧日的我也消失了

lyrics.en: Each one of us has a bucket of love
Some of us empty, some of us filled up
Cut this into pieces, break us down to the cell
lyrics.zh: 把它切成碎片，一直拆到细胞

lyrics.en: Merge us back up, we have evolved now
lyrics.zh: 再拼合回来，我们已经进化了

lyrics.en: If you turn into a flower
You must be the most delicate ever
lyrics.zh: 那一定是世上最娇嫩的一朵

lyrics.en: Even if you bloom just occasionally
You're the only perfect flower for me
lyrics.zh: 你就是我唯一完美的花

lyrics.en: If you turn into a human
I like hug the warmth come from your hands
lyrics.zh: 我想抱住你掌心传来的暖

lyrics.en: Bit of stinky breath with hair that is unruly
lyrics.zh: 呼吸有点臭，头发乱糟糟

lyrics.en: You're the only perfect human for me
lyrics.zh: 你就是我唯一完美的人

lyrics.en: I'm searching
If you're a dog
A little puppy
Going ruff ruff ruff
If you're a fruit
A tomato
Full of juice
